title: Efficacy and Safety of Anticoagulation Treatment in COVID-19 Patient Subgroups Identified by Clinical-Based Stratification and Unsupervised Machine Learning: A Matched Cohort Study
summary: retrospective single-center cohort 2,272 COVID-19 patients; propensity matching/IPTW and unsupervised four-cluster stratification; reported heterogeneous anticoagulation associations across clusters, including possible benefit cluster 3. Observational confounding precludes causal treatment claim.
